Both failures stop at the same step: 'timed out waiting for the subagent's view focused'. The screen shows the Agent Hub with the subagent listed as running but '2.5s active · 0 req' (run 2: 3.7 s, 0 req), and the line 'Agent "…" is running and cannot be revived (no reviver registered).'. The case presses alt+a and Enter once the start turn's request carrying the start message has been answered. Nothing makes it wait for the subagent's own request, although its comment says that request 'is held, so it is still running when its view is focused'. On this host the subagent has not sent it yet in about 2 of 5 runs. This is a test defect, not a product defect: the other 8 cases passed in every run.
